title: Software Lifetime Deals for Solopreneurs
subtitle: Cut your monthly software expenses with these lifetime deals currently available on AppSumo.
html:
Disclosure: this post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Running a small business or working as a freelancer often means watching your budget slowly drain away through dozens of monthly subscription fees. Every tool for marketing, customer support, and compliance adds up, making it harder to keep overhead low.

Lifetime deals offer an alternative by letting you pay once for software access. Here are five tools currently featured on AppSumo that help you manage compliance, social media, customer support, lead generation, and online reviews without ongoing monthly costs.

Mandatly: Achieve 100% cookie compliance across major global privacy standards in minutes.

Mandatly helps solopreneurs meet strict global privacy standards quickly. You can set up cookie consent banners and manage privacy regulations without needing a legal background or complex coding skills.

Before buying, check the exact plan limits on the deal page to ensure it covers your website traffic and page views. Remember that lifetime software deals depend on the company staying in business to maintain their servers and updates.

See the Mandatly deal on AppSumo

SocialNowa: Build Instagram and Facebook chatbots and schedule social posts from one platform.

SocialNowa combines social media scheduling with chatbot automation for Instagram and Facebook. It allows you to plan your content calendar and automate direct message responses to engage your audience around the clock.

Review the deal page to understand how many social accounts and team members are included in the tier you select. As with any lifetime purchase, keep in mind that platform terms from third parties like Meta can sometimes change.

See the SocialNowa deal on AppSumo

Ticksy: Build your own web-based help desk and knowledge base.

Ticksy gives you a dedicated space to manage customer inquiries and build a searchable knowledge base. It helps you keep track of support tickets and organize helpful articles so clients can find answers on their own.

Take a close look at the plan limits for agent seats and storage on the AppSumo listing before purchasing. Also, verify the refund window so you have enough time to test the platform on your own site.

See the Ticksy deal on AppSumo

Campaignware: Create unlimited quizzes and trivia games to boost lead generation.

Campaignware provides a way to attract potential customers by building interactive quizzes, trivia games, and lead capture campaigns. It helps you collect subscriber information through engaging formats rather than static contact forms.

Check the deal page to see what limits apply to monthly views or active campaigns on your chosen tier. Remember to review the refund policy if you find the tool does not fit your specific marketing workflow.

See the Campaignware deal on AppSumo

Grab Your Reviews: Collect reviews from over 50 platforms and build your online reputation.

Grab Your Reviews lets you gather feedback from more than 50 different review platforms and display them on your website. It streamlines the process of asking clients for reviews and managing your public reputation.

Verify the number of connected business locations and review requests allowed under the specific AppSumo plan. Keep in mind that lifetime deals rely on the vendor maintaining their integrations with external review sites.

See the Grab Your Reviews deal on AppSumo

How to choose

When evaluating these lifetime deals, focus strictly on the tools that solve an immediate bottleneck in your business. Buying software you do not currently need simply because it has a one-time price tag will still waste your budget.

Always read the full deal terms, check the plan tier limits, and take advantage of the refund window if a tool does not meet your expectations. Careful planning helps you build a sustainable tech stack without recurring fees.

This article was written with AI assistance from the deal information AppSumo publishes. Check each deal page for current terms before you buy.
